verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model, inference engine and fine-tuning platform, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server, hosted MCP endpoint or MCP tool interface. The REST API, CLI, llms.txt and the note about driving the platform from 'a coding agent with your API key' are adjacent building blocks, not an official MCP server.
